newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA soymeal export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 30,000 MT were mainly the result of increases for Colombia (12,900 MT), Canada (8,000 MT), and Japan (7,400 MT) being partially offset by reductions for Italy (10,000 MT).
Sales activity for the 1997/98 marketing year of 60,300 MT were mainly for Spain (30,000 MT) and unknown destinations (20,000 MT).
Exports of 46,400 MT were 35 percent less than the previous week and one-third below the 4-week average. Ecuador (15,800 MT), Japan (13,900 MT), and Canada (11,600 MT) were the major recipients.
